Literally amazing. My skin is glowing and it looks so clean. I'm very happy with my purchase.

avis.titre: Good Effective Basic Cleanser, But Less is More
avis.texte: I use a few of TO products, and wanted to give this cleanser a try. I quickly learned it works best as a second cleanse, following an oil or balm remover as the first cleanse, unless you have very oily skin. I can see why so many see the product as 'stripping'. It is HIGHLY concentrated, I use only about 1/3 of a pea size, lathered on wet hands, applied to damp face. Anything more than that is stripping, at least on my normal skin. It does have a detergent-like scent (like some plain dishwash liquids), but TO does not market for aromatherapy, so I was not expecting any scent perks:). Overall, a good basic gel cleanser, if used with moderation.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again.

I do however like your other products that I use and will have to look to see if you have another facewash that might be more suitable for my dry skin.

avis.titre: I hated this. Here is why.
avis.texte: First - The smell. It has a light but distinctly AWFUL odor. Highly reminiscent of peroxide based cleaning products, like the stuff you use to get built up grime off the inside of an oven. Second - The foam. It's practically non-existent! Third - It is only a mediocre cleanser in way of actual action. Not great, not terrible, just ok. I only gave it two stars due to the fact this did clean my face without inflaming my rosacea. This was the only selling point. I still threw it in the trash once I made it half way through the bottle though, and have no plans to ever repurchase. There are better foaming cleansers that also work with sensitive skin.

avis.titre: I would and do buy again

Sharing my skincare journey because I was desperate for help when I was trying to figure out my skincare routine. I am 26 years old, fair skin, I have never had major skin issues (acne, oiliness, dryness, etc). I used to not wash my face at all, I would only use makeup remover to take off my eye makeup and that was it. Which had worked for me for literal years without any negative side effects. About a year ago, I decided to start taking care of my skin as I was noticing my skin was fairly dull. I received a free sample of Tatcha face wash so I started using this and liked it. It worked well and my skin felt good, but all of a sudden I started having extreme breakouts, mostly on my cheeks. I couldn't figure out if it was the face wash or hormonal since my physical body was going through lots of changes too. The acne would stay for months, eventually causing scarring. I switched to using Clinique face wash and lotion, which helped control the breakouts, but it wasn't reducing the scarring on my cheeks. I was also struggling with a lot of dryness around my eyes and mouth. I wanted to find a solution to the acne scarring, controlling breakouts, and dryness. I came across the Ordinary and it has helped my skin so much in the 3-4 months that I have been using it. My acne has significantly reduced, as well as the scarring reducing and my overall skin texture is much more smooth and clear. My skin is super hydrated and I feel like my skin just looks all around better. I use the Gluc
Best facewash! Been using it since it came out. Threw out all the other bottles of the other brands right away.
Obsessed with this product!! Been using for 2 months and so happy with the results!

And I can't get over the scent -- I wondered if it had gone rancid, but after seeing other reviews with the same reaction, I know it's not just me.

I really love this cleanser. I use it in the AM, and another cleanser in the evenings for makeup removal. I used to think I had this weird dry(ish), cystic acne-prone skin. After using this with the hopes it would help repair my barrier, I actually have quite normal to oily skin. Never leaves you feeling tight after your shower, but still CLEANSES. I've bought it twice now and I won't be looking back to cerave.

avis.titre: Cleanser go to for combo to oily skin
avis.texte: This cleanser has been go to the last year and I've seen my skin transform from frequent use. It's affordable and my skin has loved it. It does what it says and smooths out the skin, my skin isn't perfect but it's healthy and clear the only concern that I have that this cleanser can't fix is my closed commodones. Note to anyone reading this: I only cleanse at night with this and I also double cleanse daily with a double cleanser. For my skin type I find double cleansing works best at reducing my acne and is what you need to do remove the sunscreen you've had on all day. Use this cleanser second after the oil cleanser! I'm not saying this cleanser shouldn't be used AM aswell it's just what works for my skin. You know your skin better than anybody. Give it a try if you are looking for a foaming cleanser it's not over stripping and really can clear a breakout with the good follow up routine in a matter of days.

I originally bought this for the first time in July when I was on holiday and had left my other face wash at home, I've been using this face wash ever since, I have super sensitive, oily acne prone skin and ever since I've used this face wash my skin has gotten so much better! Such a good price as well, I would say this tops the Paula's choice clear range.
Simple ingredients, exactly what I am looking for as I am currently pregnant.
Probably one of the best cleansers I've tried in a while. Left my skin feeling moisturized and very smooth and clean A little bit goes a long way and lasts you long enough with pleasant scent.

I used another cream cleanser for years and my skin started changing. I wanted something similar that was gentler on my skin. Tried this on a whim and I really like it. The smell is mild. It has a thinner consistency but it does the job.

I stopped having dry patches of skin on my face and have almost no acne, even when I'm on my period. My skin feels so soft and I can even put my makeup on top of my skincare without any primer! Plus the set helped me not have to watch a bunch of skincare videos to make my own set. It's so easy and so effective.

I'd say it's comparable to bleach

I tried to use the hyaluronic acid serum (which I wouldn't normally as it can sometimes be too much for my skin) but it's resulted in my skin still being so dry it's flaking. I wouldn't recommend to those who suffer with dry skin.

I think serums absorb better after cleansing with this because it gets my skin much cleaner. After going through a bunch of cleansers, I found the keeper for my daily am/pm routines. The foam is gentle and refreshing, and cleans without stripping, even if I double cleanse. After washing, my face feels ready to absorb my serums. I recommend.
Not bad, just ordinary Cleaner. The skin is smooth, the pores are lighter. There were no irritations or allergies on my combination + sensitive skin. Minus for the aroma! It really does add ammonia!

Leaves skin glowing and hydrated. For all skin types. This product has cleared my skin so much I love it so much GO BUY IT RIGHT NOWWWWW

I bought this at the start of Slow November 2023 and have used it for two months. It's a good, no-frills gentle foaming cleanser that doesn't irritate my skin or cause me to break out. The smell is okay, it's not overpowering but does have a slight chemical scent to it. The formula is quite runny so you tend to use more than you need. It can also be difficult to work the product into a foam in the evening when your skin is oily and if you've worn sunscreen that day, you'll probably need to double cleanse to get that clean feeling. I think I'll get about 3 months of use out of this product when I can typically get 4 to 4.5 months out of other cleansers. Overall, I liked using this product and would buy it again during Slow November or some other promo event but I wouldn't go out of my way to repurchase it at full price.

avis.titre: I would purchase this product over and over.

I just received my order and I'm loving this cleanser. It cleans my face without it feeling stripped. I love the jelly consistency and it's very easy to rub in and doesn't slide all over your hands. This is the first cleanser I've tried from the brand and won't be the last.

avis.titre: Off-putting smell and doesn't really do anything for my skin
avis.texte: I'd say I have dry skin, but my nose will get oily - so I guess combination, but not in the T-zone, just my nose. I've also read that this isn't great for dry skin, but I've had other foaming cleansers and they work so well with my skin, so I thought I'd give this a try. Right away, it smells like wet dog. I know it's fragrance free, but this is just hard to use on my face with a scent like that.. And after using it for a while, it really did nothing for my skin. It didn't feel clean, my skin didn't feel smooth or soft, but also not dried out. Just felt like my skin if I woke up and didn't wash it. Oh, it also really didn't foam unless I REALLY rubbed my hands together which is not what I'm used to from a FOAMING cleanser lol. I dunno, it just didn't work for me so I wouldn't be buying again. Shame because it's my first product from the Ordinary and now I'm not sure if I'll try others because I don't think they fit my skin type.
This product has literally become a STAPLE in my everyday morning face routine. It doesn't have much of smell, but that's what I like. The ingredients are so good for you too!

I'm in my late 30s with superrr oily skin and Hispanic. This super cleans my face and does not leave it dryed out like Neutrogena did. Will definitely keep buying this for life. Also it's super consentrated so you only need about half a grape size.

Clearing my acne!!! For the past couple months I've tried so much to clear my acne and not much was helping. I had been using the Cerave foaming facial cleanser and I noticed my skin would always feel dry and tight and my acne always looked worse after cleansing. I switched to this and noticed immediate results!!! This makes my skin feel so soft after washing and my acne started clearing up. I use this along with azleic acid and my acne is finally starting to go away. I've only been using this cleanser for a few days!! I would 1000% recommend this cleanser. I will say it does have a little bit of a medical smell but that doesn't bother me.

Honestly, I don't love it. My biggest issue was that it smells really bad (rancid), but I couldn't decide whether it's just mine (maybe it went bad?) or it's how it's supposed to be. The cleanser itself wasn't bad at all, I don't mind that it's not foaming like crazy. Hence I'll give it another chance.

avis.titre: My skin his never glowed like this before.
avis.texte: After being consistent, this cleanser has given me real hope that I could maintain clearer skin. Not only has it help my texture but my confidence! Im in love with it! This and a moisturizer before a long sleep, i wake up with baby skin. After 2 weeks, makeup isnt even needed, i just put on concealer, blush, and mascara and my skin already glows! Thank you ordinary!!!

This has turned out to be one of my most favorite face washes. I used Clinique purple for years. This is the only thing that I think that I do like better my skin tends to look better and less acne. I still use my clinic, exfoliating, toner+ lotion
This product is very light on the face. It doesn't feel too heavy and it has a soft smell to it. Great product if you're sensitive to smells. Highly recommend

It looks plain and basic, but it is anything but!! This cleanser deserves a tiny fireworks show to celebrate it's effectiveness at a moderate price.
I have skin that is combination, and some cleansers make it feel more on the dry side. That is not the case with this, very gentle on my skin and love that it does not have a scent.

avis.titre: Good cleanser for morning or night
avis.texte: This wasn't my favorite the first time I used it, but it grew on me quickly. It has a smell but it washes off so it doesn't bother me.

This product is very good at cleansing the face without leaving it dry. My face stays moisturized even after i have used it. Usually ehen i use cleansers my face up dryer than before i started but this product is a game changer. I highly recommend.
